selection_rule: minimum correct latency in the complete measured configuration pool; ties use original index

contention.policy: discard and retry any shard with an observed foreign compute process
contention.limitation: process polling cannot exclude interference shorter than the polling interval

example_comparison.aggregation: Pool samples within each physical GPU; report the median across GPUs, weighting each physical GPU equally. Speedup is the median of the per-GPU ratios of median latencies.
